help.title: Help & documentation
help.subtitle: From an idea to a saved configuration.
help.startProjectDesc: Create ROM walks through identity, exact device variant, Android base and review. Catalog identification does not establish build support.
help.shapeConfigDesc: Open a saved project in the ten-stage Visual Builder. Appearance and app selections update the conceptual display. Save commits a revision; Undo restores your previous local edit. Export downloads the configuration JSON.
help.understandPreviewDesc: The automatic 3D preview is a generic configuration concept. It is not an emulator, compiled firmware or proof of compatibility. Cloud compilation is unavailable.
help.manageAccessDesc: Settings lists active sessions and lets you revoke access or sign out. Theme and language preferences are saved on this browser.
